component.name: WiredPad
component.summary: Use your tablet as an extra display over USB

description.p: WiredPad connects a compatible iPad to a Linux desktop over USB. It creates a virtual display and sends the desktop to the tablet, with absolute pointer input.
A compatible Wired XDisplay client, the EVDI display driver and a paired USB device are required. Compatibility is currently tested on Plasma Wayland with a legacy iPad client.
